content: Yjui ne' 'in yu Jacobo, lo' msu'hua ne' 'in yu Tyo na'an chcuan
Cui' xacan', yu nu lca ree Herode msu'hua yu 'in tucua snan jun nu cua' ya qui'an ti' 'in Jesús na'an chcuan, si'yana xitijin ne' 'in jun nu ti'i,
ngulo yu tñan si'yana xi'yu yni yu Jacobo, ta'a ngula yu Xuhua.
Na'an yu ree can' si'yana mdiyaa 'a ti' ne' judio ña'an nu m'ni yu, xacan' ngunan yu ña'an nu quinu yu Tyo lja ta'a Pascua xa nchcu ne' jaslya nu a yu'hui suun.

Xa nguinu yu Tyo can', msu'hua ne' 'in yu na'an chcuan. Mdyaa ne' cunta 'in yu yaa' tsa jacua ta yu sindatu nu chu'hui cuan 'in yu, jacua yu scaa ta yu. Lca cha' 'in yu ree can' si'yana culyoo ne' 'in yu Tyo can', lo' tloo nten quichen can' ca cuiya' cha' 'in yu xa tsatii ta'a can',
can' cha' tsu'hue 'a ntsu'hui ne' cuan 'in yu. Una chcui lja xacan' a ndla' ti' jun chcui' lyi'o jun 'in Ndiose si'ya cha' 'in yu.
Xa ngulyoo angujle 'in yu Tyo na'an chcuan

Cua' xca ti tla can' nu cu'ni cuiya' Herode cha' 'in yu Tyo, lo' yu re lja' yu tlu'hue la lja tucua yu sindatu can', nchcan' tsu'hue yaa' yu lo'o carena, nchgaa la ña'an yu sindatu can' ndon yu cuan nde tuna'an lyiya'.

Tsati ntyin msti sca xaa ña'an chcuan can' xa ngu'ya ton sca angujle 'in Ñi X'nan na, yla' sii' yu Tyo can' si'yana tyi'o sla yu, lo' juin 'in yu: Ndla ti cu'ni lo' tyitucui. Cui' ña'an lcaa nguitin' carena can' yaa' yu.
Ti' juin la 'in yu: Xcan' sii' lo' su'hua snan. Lo' cuaña'an m'ni yu. Ti' juin angujle can': Quixen ste' lo' chcui ncha'an 'ñan.
Xacan' mducui ncha'an yu 'in angujle can', una a ñan ti' yu si'yana cha' ñi ca ña'an nu ngui'ni can' lo'o yu, msque' ti' yu si'yana nchcui' sla ti yu.

Xa mdijin yu se'en ndon yu sindatu nu cua' nchca tucua ta can', nguila yu se'en ndon tuna'an tlyu nu nguia' lo'o chcuan, ycuii' na nguila na, xacan' mdyi'o ton yu nde lyiya'. Lo' xa mdiyaa yu se'en ndyaa cusi tucueen can', mdo'o tso' angujle can' sii' yu.

La xacan' nguila cha' tiyaa 'in yu, lo' juin yu: La ñii ncua cuiya' tin' si'yana Ñi X'nan na ngua'an tñan ñi angujle nu ngulo laa 'ñan tuyaa' Herode lo'o ne' judio, ña'an nu ncua ti' ne' cu'ni lyi'o ne' 'ñan.

Xa nu ngu'ya tsu'hue ca yu cunta cha' can', mdo'o yu nguiaa yu la na'an 'in María, jyi'an yu Xuhua, yu nu nchcui' ne' lo'o lca Marco. Can' qui'an 'a jun ndiyo' ti'in jun, nchcui' lyi'o jun 'in Ndiose.
Xa ngune ycui' yu Tyo tuna'an lyiya', mdo'o sca nu cuna'an tsa suhue ti naan Rode, ya na'an cha' ti ca lca can',
una cui' xaa yu'hui lyoo tyi'i nchcui' yu Tyo can'. Loo nu tsu'hue ntsu'hui tiquee, ñi a msla tuna'an can', cui' xaa nguia ytsa' 'in jun si'yana yu Tyo ndon yu tuna'an lyiya' can'.
Lo' juin jun 'in: Na ndiyo' nu'huin. Mxcuen nu cuna'an can': Nu cha' ñi ca, cua ndon. Xiya' juin jun 'in: Cui' angujle nu nsñi cunta 'in yu ca lca cua.
Yu Tyo can' a ndla ti' yu ndon ycui' yu tuna'an can', lo' xa msla jun 'in na ndyijyin ya' yuhue ti' jun xa na'an jun 'in yu.

M'ni yaa' yu si'yana seen tyi'in jun, mdyisnan mtsa' yu ña'an ngulyoo Ñi X'nan na 'in yu na'an chcuan can', lo' juin yu: Cu'ni um cha' tsu'hue quitsa' um 'in yu Jacobo lo'o nchgaa la ña'an jun ta'a na cha' re. Xacan' mdo'o yu nguiaa yu xca se'en.
Una xa ngu'ya xaa can', lyee 'a nguilo ti'in yu sindatu si'ya cha' 'in yu Tyo can', cha' ña'an ncua mdyi'o yu.

Yu Herode can' ngulo yu tñan si'yana quia nan ne' 'in yu, una a la nguija lyoo yu, lo' xa cua' mxicunee yu 'in nchgaa yu nu yu'hui cuan can', mdo'o tñan si'yana caja yu. Chon' nde'en la can', yu Herode mdo'o yu se'en lca Judea lo' mdiyaa yu se'en lca Cesarea.
Xa ngujui yu ree Herode

Yu Herode can' ycuen tique' yu lo'o nten ndi'in quichen Tiro lo'o Sidón. Una mdya ycui' ne' cha' ña'an cu'ni chu'hue ne' cha' 'in ne' tloo ree can', lo' mjñan ne' cha' tsu'hue 'in yu Blasto, sca yu nu lyi'ya tñan tloo ree, si'yana chcui' yu cha' 'in ne' se'en nu ca'an tñan la yu ree can' na nu cunajo'o 'in ne'.
Xa mdiyaa tsaan can', yten tucua yu Herode se'en ndlo yu tñan, lco' yu sca te' tsu'hue ña'an, xacan' mdyisnan mda cueen yu 'in nten can'.
Ycui' cueen nten can' lo'o yu: Ycui' ca Ndiose lca nu nchcui' re, lo' si'i 'a nten chendyu.
Ticui' xaa ngu'ya ton sca angujle 'in Ñi X'nan na, m'ni cha' msñi sca quicha 'in yu, mdyisnan ytsu yu'hui cunu' 'in yu lo' ngujui yu, cui' si'yana a mdaa yu loo Ndiose tloo nten can'.
Cha' tsu'hue 'in Ñi X'nan na nde lyee la nguia nguine yu'hui na, ncua qui'an la nten nu ya qui'an ti' 'in ñi.
Yu Bernabé lo'o yu Saulo, xa cua' msu'hua ta yu tñan nu yaa yu quichen Jerusalén, mxitucui yu nde Antioquía, lo' nguia lo'o yu 'in yu Xuhua nu nchcui' ne' lo'o lca Marco.
